title: Independent Pd2Cl6 4d-to-2p XES hypothesis test
difficulty_reasons: The fixed eight-atom system makes this a direct calculation, but relativistic core spectroscopy, transition-level orbital assignment, geometry validation, and line-shape sensitivity must all be reconciled.

paper.title: Evaluating Palladium 4d-to-2p X-ray Emission Spectroscopy for Characterizing Catalytically Relevant Species

data.description: Public neutral-singlet Pd2Cl6 eight-atom starting geometry.

required_deliverables.description: Structured spectrum, validation, transition analysis, verdict, and limitations.
